text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year. Thank you for all your 
help this past year.
choice_data_list: Likewise!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. I'll be counting on you this year 
too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...We will likely face far more hardships 
this year than ever before."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
You already understand the ideal I must 
strive for, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. Are you prepared?"
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Triple Tiara.
Let us aim for the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. Looks like you're already 
prepared.
choice_data_list:
Because the ideal you strive for is my 
ideal too.

Because the ideal you strive for is my 
ideal too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
—Good grief, you really are something 
else.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as we finished reaffirming each 
other's determination and took a brief 
breather—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I've been thinking this for a 
while now, but you... Even though it's the 
New Year, you're far too much your usual 
self."
choice_data_list: Like usual?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Look at this Trainer's office. It has no 
sense of season whatsoever, does it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Valuing annual traditions and giving life 
rhythm is essential to having a fulfilling 
year.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy also places great value on 
seasonal customs. ...You can hardly set a 
good example behaving like this.
choice_data_list: S-sorry...
I-I'm so sorry...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Tell me if there's anything New 
Year-like you want to do.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I suppose I could help you out, just this 
once. You'd better be grateful."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked that, the New Year's activity that 
came to mind was—
choice_data_list: Maybe put up a big New Year's decoration?
I haven't eaten ozoni yet.

Shall we do our first calligraphy of the 
year?

Shall we do our first calligraphy of the 
year?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked that, the New Year's activity that 
came to mind was—
choice_data_list: Maybe put up a big New Year's decoration?
I haven't eaten ozoni yet.

Shall we do our first calligraphy of the 
year?

Shall we do our first calligraphy of the 
year?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. Judging by appearance first isn't a 
bad call. Though calling it "big" is a bit 
crude...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, the Academy has 
spare New Year's decorations. Using those 
should make things look a bit better.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright. Now that it's settled, we'll 
carry it in. You help out too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After carrying everything in and 
decorating—
choice_data_list: Such a New Year's vibe...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It tends to be a bit too noisy, but... I 
suppose it's a passing grade.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Only by refreshing your mindset like this 
can you truly put your heart into 
training.
choice_data_list:
Then let's get right into our very first 
training session.

Then shall we get right into our very 
first training session?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "—Heh. Not a bad proposition."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, right at the start of the new 
year, the two of us redoubled our 
motivation.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh-What... did you say... !?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Unbelievable. To think one could lose 
their sense of the seasons to such an 
extent...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Starting the New Year without eating ozoni 
is unthinkable! We must deal with this 
immediately...!
choice_data_list: Th-that much...?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
It is that serious! Where were you born? 
Give me all the details so I can recreate 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting an unexpected chance to eat Air 
Groove's homemade ozoni made me feel like 
I struck a little luck.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Heh, not a bad proposal. Especially since 
it's something we truly need right now.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The complete set of equipment is in the 
Student Council Room, so I will lend it to 
you.
choice_data_list: You're well prepared.
You're well prepared.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
The student council does New Year's 
calligraphy every year. ...So, what will 
you be writing?
choice_data_list: Maybe "Triple Tiara Achieved"?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...What a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, using the tools Air Groove 
prepared, we each wrote "Achieve the 
Triple Tiara".

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even with the same characters, the ones 
she wrote were more powerful and beautiful 
than my own—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It was a note truly characteristic of her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I was about to head into the 
year's first training with Air Groove 
feeling refreshed—

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: Ah— It's here!

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san! Trainer-san! We've been 
waiting for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...An interview, is it? It seems you've 
obtained permission from the academy.

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Could you please tell us about your plan 
for the Classic Year!?

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"Fans are already talking about the 
possibility of a Classic Triple Crown, 
but...!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. You don't mind, do you?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove asks to confirm once more. My 
resolve is already set, so I nod in reply.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
“—I, Air Groove, hereby declare that I 
will pursue the Tiara route in the Classic 
Year.”

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text: I-It's here! The Tiara route! Which means—

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text:
"So you will be running in the Oaks as 
well! How do you feel about aiming for a 
mother-daughter double victory...!?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...First, I shall face the Oka Sho before 
me with everything I have."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"You will be able to see my devotion to 
the Tiara route through my performance in 
the Oka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I have training coming up, so 
please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as the new year dawned, the 
Classic Year with Air Groove began.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our aim is the Triple Tiara. First up is 
the Oka Sho!!
